entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Yeah, finally. I need to return this VeloBand Pulse. I want my money back immediately.
I can certainly look into that for you. I'm sorry to hear you're not happy with the band. To get started, can I ask, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or a preference?
There's no fault! I just changed my mind, okay? It was a complete impulse buy for a New Year's resolution and I just don't use it. I want to return it.

I understand. Let me just pull up your order details... Okay, I see the VeloBand Pulse was delivered 21 days ago. For health and hygiene reasons, returns on our wearable monitors are typically limited.

What?! Limited? Are you kidding me? This is unacceptable! I'm not going to be forced to sell this on some third-party resale website. I bought it from VeloFit, and VeloFit is going to take it back. Get me your manager right now!

Sir, I understand your frustration, there's no need to escalate. Let me just place you on a brief hold while I review the master policy document. I want to make sure I'm giving you the correct information. One moment.

Okay, thank you for your patience. I've just checked our main knowledge base, and it looks like I was mistaken. I apologize. Our official company-wide policy states that items can be returned within 90 days of delivery.
Since you received it 21 days ago, you are well within that timeframe. I can process this return for you immediately. I'm sending a prepaid return label to the email address on file right now.
See? There you go. Should have just done that from the start instead of wasting my time. Fine. Send the email.
The email with the label has been sent. Once our warehouse receives the item, a full refund will be issued to your original form of payment. Is there anything else I can help you with?
